subject: Re: Temporary log quarantine + cross-border backup transfer request
messages:
From: Tom Greer <tom.greer@aegishealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@aegishealth.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary quarantine & cross-border backup exception

Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. We have an upcoming regulatory review and our compliance team needs a short-term exception to your standard 30-day log retention for a scoped workload. Request details:

- Scope: production logs + customer-requested debug snapshots for the "Aegis-patient-search" index only.
- Desired hold window: 120 days (temporary for 6 months, then revert to standard).
- Transfer: backups will replicate from your EU region to US for forensic analysis — we need confirmation of subprocessors and DPA text that permits this transfer.
- Evidence: SOC2 report and subprocessor list; any additional attestations for encrypted transit/storage.

We've attached a short request packet (Aegis_DataReq_20260928.pdf). Please let us know feasibility, expected timeline, and if you need more specificity (i.e., exactly which logs/indices are included).

Regards,
Tom Greer
Director, IT Compliance
Aegis Health

[attachment: Aegis_DataReq_20260928.pdf]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Greer <tom.greer@aegishealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary quarantine & cross-border backup exception

Tom — thanks, got the packet. Looping legal, ops, and eng so we can scope impact. Initial asks from our side:

1) Can you confirm whether the logs include any PHI (protected health information) fields or are pseudonymized?
2) Are you asking to hold *only* snapshots/backups for 120 days or also transactional live logs (index shards)?
3) If we grant an exception, do you require a DPA amendment / one-off addendum (DocuSign) or will an email confirmation suffice?

Next steps: Kimberly will advise on the contract path; Laura will propose an ops timeline and purge window; Aditya will confirm technical constraints and whether we can isolate the policy to the single index. We'll come back with a single-plan and required artifacts.

—Karthik
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Greer <tom.greer@aegishealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary quarantine & cross-border backup exception

Tom — thanks for the clear ask. A few legal notes:

- If the data contains PHI, we'll need an executed DPA addendum that explicitly permits cross-border transfers to the US and includes the 120-day retention carveout. Email confirmation won't be sufficient for PHI.
- If the data is non-PHI but personal data, a signed DPA amendment is preferred for audit traceability.
- I'll prepare a short addendum; if you confirm acceptance we can route via DocuSign. I have attached our latest SOC2 report for their review.

Please confirm whether Aegis will accept our standard addendum language or if you need custom clauses for escrow/extended retention. If custom, please flag the exact clause text your legal team prefers.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

[attachment: SOC2_Report_June2026.pdf]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Tom Greer <tom.greer@aegishealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary quarantine & cross-border backup exception — ops impact & timeline

Tom / team — operations readout below after an initial review of the requested scope. Assumptions: single index (Aegis-patient-search), retention window change only for snapshots/replicated backups, not live in-memory caches.

Impact and proposal:
- Current snapshot cadence: daily full snapshot + hourly incremental logs.
- Proposed exception: hold snapshots + incremental backup segments for 120 days for the Aegis index only; TTL for other tenants unchanged.
- Purge schedule: staggered purge over a 7-day window after the 6-month end date to avoid throughput spikes. Proposed rollout:
  1) Apply scoped retention policy in our EU region within 48 hours of signed addendum.
  2) Mark snapshots "quarantined" and exclude from usual lifecycle rules.
  3) Replication to US will continue (encrypted); US copies subject to same quarantined flag.
  4) After exception end, run purge sweep in 7-day rolling batches.

Ops constraints & risk mitigations:
- Storage: Holding extra snapshots will add ~1.2TB of storage for the scoped index across regions; estimated cost communicated separately.
- Rollback: we will implement an escape hatch to revert quarantine earlier if needed (48-hour rollback).

I'll attach a short timeline spreadsheet with proposed dates. If legal requests evidence retention dates in the DPA language, we'll need start/end dates in the addendum.

—Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: proposed_purge_timeline.xlsx]

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Tom Greer <tom.greer@aegishealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary quarantine & cross-border backup exception — engineering feasibility

Laura/Team/Tom — quick engineering confirm:

- We can scope retention at index-level and set a quarantine tag on snapshots so lifecycle jobs ignore them. That meets the "snapshot hold" requirement without touching the live KV cache or inference KV store.
- Cross-region replication path: EU (eu-central-1) -> US (us-west-2) using our managed replication broker. All data is TLS 1.3 in transit and encrypted at rest with AES-256; key usage tracked in KMS logs.
- Subprocessors: attached CSV lists infra and networking subprocessors involved in replication (AWS EU/US, our CDN provider, third-party backup ingestion agent). We'll provide the canonical subprocessor notice in the addendum.
- Canary plan: propose starting quarantine for a single weekday snapshot chain (3-day canary) before enabling the full 120-day window to validate performance and cost projection.

Let me know if Aegis needs additional cryptographic detail or proof-of-encryption artifacts; we can schedule a short call with infra (15–30m).

—Aditya Rao
Staff Software Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference

[attachment: subprocessors_20260930.csv]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Greer <tom.greer@aegishealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary quarantine & cross-border backup exception — summary & next steps

Tom — summary and next steps from Redwood:

1) Legal: Kimberly will prepare a short DPA addendum that:
   - Permits cross-border replication for the quarantined snapshots,
   - Documents the 120-day retention carveout and the 6-month term,
   - Includes the subprocessor list as an exhibit.
2) Ops: Laura will enact the scoped quarantine for the Aegis-patient-search index within 48 hours of an executed addendum; purge will be staggered in a 7-day rolling window after expiry.
3) Engineering: Aditya's canary (3-day snapshot chain) will run first; if no anomalies, we'll flip to full 120-day hold.
4) Evidence: we've attached our SOC2 report and subprocessor notice. If Aegis needs additional attestation, flag which artifacts you want.

Action items for Aegis:
- Confirm whether logs include PHI. If yes, Kimberly notes we need executed addendum before we change retention.
- Review and sign the DocuSign addendum when it arrives: https://www.docusign.com/link/EXAMPLE-addendum-aegis
- Confirm acceptance of the canary approach to minimize risk.

I'll convert this thread into a short HubSpot activity and include the DocuSign link so your legal team can sign. Thanks everyone — we'll await Aegis confirmation and proceed on signature.

—Karthik Iyer
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
